title: Fresh Mango Sorbet with Lemon
summary: Bright and refreshing mango sorbet infused with a hint of lemon, intensely fruity and palate-cleansing.

ingredients.item: medium ripe mangoes, peeled and stoned
glucose syrup or light corn syrup

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the peeled and stoned flesh of 3 medium ripe mangoes with 120 ml cold water until completely smooth.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the mango purée, 165 g sugar, 2 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tbsp glucose syrup together on and off for several minutes until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Set the bowl over iced water to speed cooling.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill the mixture until 4 °C or colder.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn in an ice cream maker until frozen and thick.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Scrape into a container, seal and freeze for several hours until firm.

tips: Check that sugar has fully dissolved by rubbing a finger on the bowl base for any remaining crystals
Chill the mixture thoroughly before churning for the best frozen texture
Choose ripe mangoes with a fragrant aroma for the most flavourful sorbet
storage: Keep frozen for up to 3 days.
